fact: The Plano de Desenvolvimento Nacional 2023-2027 sets, under priority 12.4.1, the integration of the whole public school network into the Sistema Integrado de Gestão Escolar (SIGE) with regular supply of data, and the digitalisation of school administration including the registration of enrolments and assessments, as things still to be done.
title: Plano de Desenvolvimento Nacional 2023–2027
